role_grants_single_scope.name: role_grants_single_scope
role_grants_single_scope.value: not ("role_grants"."site_id" is not null and "role_grants"."department_id" is not null)

projects_dates_ck.name: projects_dates_ck
projects_dates_ck.value: "projects"."due_date" is null or "projects"."start_date" is null or "projects"."due_date" >= "projects"."start_date"

recurring_cadence_fields_ck.name: recurring_cadence_fields_ck
recurring_cadence_fields_ck.value: ("recurring_task_definitions"."cadence" <> 'WEEKLY' or "recurring_task_definitions"."weekday" between 0 and 6) and ("recurring_task_definitions"."cadence" <> 'MONTHLY' or "recurring_task_definitions"."month_day" between 1 and 28)
